flags: Cover (5655) + contents/artist-index (5656) grouped as one book.
books.title_suggestion: Hall of Fame: Artists & Their Hits — Armed Forces Song Folio Music Book, Volume XXVIII
books.identification_note: Multi-artist U.S. Army Special Services 'Armed Forces Song Folio' compilation. Contents are an early-1970s mix of The Beatles, George Harrison (solo), Creedence Clearwater Revival, Neil Diamond, Chicago, and Burt Bacharach/Hal David hits. Several captured titles ('Tweetin' Up The Country', 'Features Green', '(Trip) Best Thing') appear to be OCR/scan garbling and could not be matched to a definitive song; kept verbatim and flagged.

books.title: Satie: Piano Works (Collection)
flags: Comprehensive Satie collection; exact edition/title not captured.
books.title_suggestion: Gymnopédies, Gnossiennes and Other Works for Piano (Dover Publications)
books.identification_note: The 17-piece contents (Sarabandes through Vieux Sequins et Vieilles Cuirasses, in this exact order) match the Dover edition 'Gymnopédies, Gnossiennes and Other Works for Piano' (ISBN 9780486259781) exactly.

songs.title: Sarabandes (1887)
songs.notes: Set of three sarabandes with prophetic unresolved harmonies.

songs.title: Gymnopédies (Gymnopaedias) (1888)
songs.notes: The famous Trois Gymnopédies.

songs.title: Trois Gnossiennes [Three Dances of Knossos (?)] (1890)
songs.notes: Free-meter pieces with whimsical performance directions.

songs.title: Le Fils des Étoiles: Wagnérie Kaldéenne du Sâr Péladan [The Son of the Stars: A Chaldean Wagnery by Sâr Péladan] (1891)
songs.notes: Rosicrucian-era preludes built on quartal harmony.

songs.title: Sonneries de la Rose + Croix [Trumpet Calls of the Rose + Cross] (1892)
songs.notes: Solemn fanfares for the Rosicrucian order.

songs.title: Prélude de La Porte Héroïque du Ciel [Prelude to The Heroic Gate of Heaven] (1894)
Pièces Froides [Cold Pieces] (1897)
songs.notes: Two sets: 'Airs à faire fuir' and 'Danses de travers'.

songs.title: Poudre d'Or [Gold Dust] (c. 1901)
songs.notes: Cabaret-style concert waltz.

songs.title: 5 Morceaux en Forme de Poire (à 4 mains) avec une Manière de Commencement, une Prolongation du même & un En Plus, suivi d'une Redite [5 Pieces in Pear Form (for four hands) with a By Way of a Beginning, an Extension of the Same, and an In Addition, followed by a Repetition] (1903)
songs.notes: Satire of academic criticism; for piano four hands.

songs.title: En Habit de Cheval [In Riding Habit] (four hands) (1911)
songs.notes: Includes mock-contrapuntal 'chorales' and 'fugues'; for piano four hands.

songs.title: Aperçus Désagréables [Unpleasant Observations] (four hands) (1912)
songs.notes: Pastorale, Choral and Fugue, for piano four hands.

songs.title: Véritables Préludes Flasques (pour un chien) [Genuine Flabby Preludes (for a dog)] (1912)
songs.notes: Part of Satie's 'humoristic' suites with running text directions.

songs.title: Descriptions Automatiques [Automatic Descriptions] (1913)
songs.notes: Quotes folk tunes amid satirical commentary.

songs.title: Embryons Desséchés [Dried Embryos] (1913)
songs.notes: Parodies crustaceans; mock-grandiose Beethoven-quoting endings.

songs.title: Croquis et Agaceries d'un Gros Bonhomme en Bois [Sketches and Provocations of a Portly Wooden Mannikin] (1913)
Chapitres Tournés en Tous Sens [Chapters Turned Every Which Way] (1913)

songs.title: Sonatine, 1905, dedicated to Mr. and Mrs. Ida Godebski
songs.notes: Three movements: Modéré, Mouvement de menuet, Animé.

songs.title: Miroirs, 1904-05

songs.title: Gaspard de la nuit (Aspild Dodger of the Night), 1908
